items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I just recently, well last year, did a gig with Noel Redding... So we did, like we were doing Hendrix tunes with Eric Schenkman... and Noel Redding, and I’m playing drums.

ctx.x: Yeah, the first show was in New York at the old Lone Star, the one with the iguana outside. And it was a real rush, it really was. That was the first experience I had like the whole group coming together and saying a prayer before going out in front of the — you know it was real hype type stuff. And you know thousands of people out there screaming “Fagan, yo, Steely Dan,” they were wanting this tune and that tune. We didn’t do those, we did other stuff. But it was great. No playing with people like that it’s…
That’s so funny. Here you are playing—
